summary: Elevate your project management skills with our cloud computing fundamentals course. Learn key concepts to manage projects efficiently in the cloud era.
lede: Cloud project management training helps project managers coordinate cloud initiatives without needing to write production code. It covers classifying workloads across IaaS, PaaS and SaaS, assessing readiness, mapping dependencies, and planning migration waves with clear roles and risks. Participants also practise building project plans and cost baselines, reviewing consumption variance, and reporting progress against business outcomes.
audienceIntro: Cloud computing project delivery requires enough technical fluency to coordinate specialists, challenge assumptions, and connect architecture decisions with scope, schedule, risk, cost, and benefits. This course suits professionals who manage or support cloud initiatives but do not need to write production code.
modules: Cloud Security, Compliance, and Data Governance
Cloud Costs, Metrics, and Digital Control
Cloud Project Reporting and Adoption Roadmap
prerequisites: You need a working understanding of project scope, schedules, risks, budgets, and stakeholder coordination. You do not need coding skills or prior experience configuring AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud environments. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the templates during exercises, although the course can run with facilitator-provided materials. Advanced cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, AI-assisted analysis, and cost engineering receive conceptual or operational treatment. The course focuses on project coordination and decision support rather than production implementation.
